headline: Linn of Mercy Settles Under Colonial Flags as Fisherman's Row Erupts
war_summary: Twelve hours after our last edition, the Linn of Mercy presents a settled face: all eleven of its posts now fly Colonial colors, though the casualty rolls there still climb, the Warden toll running heaviest. Fisherman's Row has flared instead, Fort Ember the busiest ground of the past day and a Warden flag once more visible on the row, which now counts eight posts Colonial to one Warden. On Farranac Coast, fighting about Transient Valley ran to the very minute of this dispatch, leaving nine posts Colonial, one Warden and one in no-man's-land. The Weathered Expanse holds at six Warden to three Colonial, Crow's Nest and Frostmarch its most-troubled ground, casualty rates accelerating anew. Stonecradle has logged no change of flags since early morning, yet its day's price — some sixteen thousand Warden and ten thousand Colonial casualties — tells of a grinding, unbroken struggle. The Dead Lands bleed heavily without a recorded base action, and Stlican Shelf remains divided five Warden to four Colonial about Thornhold. No victor is declared; thirty-four victory towns remain the prize.
